Ashford Arthritis and Rheumatology
Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Viktor Whitlock | DOB: 08/17/1982 | MRN: SYN-8407824
Date of service: 10/07/2025 | Dr. Kaveh Jessop, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
43-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hyperlipidemia, seasonal allergies.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
He has taken weekly methotrexate (25 mg) for the better part of six months, yet the small joints of both hands remain swollen.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: active seropositive rheumatoid arthritis; clinical disease activity index thirty-one today.
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 09/23/2025 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
